text: Pantry Before Shopping. Plan dinner from recorded supplies, then keep the final say over what gets used.
This guided demo calls a real self-hosted MCP server. The starting pantry is synthetic; this is not a live Alexa connection.
Two dinners share the same pantry. Three tomato portions cover rice and beans, then pasta. Previewing consumes nothing.
Every portion is tied to a recorded lot and its source. Date labels set planning priority, not food safety.
Only explicit cooking confirmation consumes supplies. A durable receipt records both dinners. The same preview cannot be confirmed twice.
Reload the page: the receipt and updated pantry remain. State lives locally, with no cloud account or paid API.
Plan again and the missing supplies appear. There is no confirmation button while the plan has shopping gaps.
Record supplies only after you have them. Any pantry change invalidates older previews, so another person’s update cannot silently change dinner.
Inspect, preview, confirm and restock use the same MCP tools a compatible assistant can call. No shopping orders or automatic purchases.
A small household tool with clear boundaries: recorded supplies, exact gaps, explicit confirmation. Built for the self-hosted MCP track.
